verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a web-scraping service, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes a hosted API reached with an API key, plus a CLI and an MCP server that front that hosted service. Community comments suggest running other local tools instead of ScrapingBee, which is a user-side workaround rather than a self-hostable ScrapingBee.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
